hints.title: Equivalence Relations and Smallest Root
hints.text: Character equivalence forms connected components across the 26 letters. Within each component, every character can be substituted with the component lexicographical minimum.

hints.title: Directed Disjoint Set Linking
hints.text: When uniting two components, always designate the smaller character as the representative root of the larger one.

hints.title: Base String Translation
hints.text: After processing all equivalence pairs from s1 and s2, transform baseStr by replacing each character with the representative root of its set.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of s1 and s2
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running graph searches for each character individually repeats component traversals redundantly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Disjoint set union over 26 letters uses constant auxiliary space and runs in near-linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize equivalence relations as connected components and maintain the minimum character as representative root.
complexity.notes: Alphabet size is strictly 26 lowercase English letters.
